text: {"label":"Conditioned Reinforcers and Reinforcer Functions","definition":"Research on how stimuli become conditioned reinforcers and on reinforcer properties such as delay, timing, distribution, and discriminative effects, and how these properties shape responding, discrimination, and resurgence.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on establishing conditioned reinforcers and on reinforcers' temporal and discriminative functions, rather than preference assessment and choice, response–reinforcer dependencies, or treating problem behavior with alternative reinforcement."}
